paper_title: Axion Dark Matter Search around 4.55 $μ$eV with Dine-Fischler-Srednicki-Zhitnitskii Sensitivity
notes: CAPP-12TB haloscope (IBS-CAPP) axion dark matter search excluding g_agamma down to ~6.2e-16 GeV^-1 (DFSZ sensitivity) over 4.51-4.59 ueV at 90% CL, assuming axions are 100% of local DM with rho_a = 0.45 GeV/cm^3. The detailed exclusion curve is in Fig. 4 (not tabulated); I encoded the paper's stated representative limit as a flat two-point bound over the stated mass range. Note a small gap (~380 kHz) around 4.527 ueV due to mode crossings is not captured.
